datasets.name: High-precision aerial landslide imagery around Sichuan Province since 2008
datasets.verbatim: High-precision aerial landslide imagery around Sichuan Province since 2008, a publicly available dataset totaling 59 sheets (Zeng et al. 2022).

datasets.name: Google search engine high-definition landslide image data
datasets.verbatim: free high-definition landslide image data obtained through Google search engine, totaling 50 sheets

methods.name: CBAM-U-net
methods.summary: A U-Net architecture modified by introducing a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) consisting of a Spatial Attention Module (SPM) and a Channel Attention Module (CAM) into each down-sampling process to improve feature representation and reduce semantic gap.
methods.verbatim: this paper proposed the U-net with a progressive Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM-U-net) for landslide boundary identification and extraction from high-precision aerial imagery.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study.'

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom CBAM-U-net code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
